packageRules.description: The root package.json declares no dependencies and has no lockfile. Leaving it enabled would make Renovate create a package-lock.json for it on the first run.
Every dependency update is a chore, and the conventional-commit scope falls back to `deps` for anything not covered by a more specific rule below.
Non-major SDK npm dependencies land in one reviewable PR.
Non-major frontend npm dependencies land in one reviewable PR.
All @stellar/* packages are bumped together. A stellar-sdk major release changes the wire format the SDK builds against, so it gets its own PR; everything below a major moves as one batch.
Rust crates used by the contracts.
Python SDK dependencies (stellar-sdk and pytest). The poetry manager supersedes pep621 for pyproject.toml, so both names are listed.
GitHub Actions pins move monthly rather than weekly: a new action major release is usually a runtime change that deserves its own review.
schedule: before 4am on the 1st day of the month
